faqs.a:
The council, except as hereinabove expressly limited, may in the letting of contracts
               impose such conditions upon bidders with regard to bonds and to securities, and such
               guaranties of good and faithful performance, completion of any work and the keeping
               of the same in repair, and may provide for any further matter or thing in connection
               therewith as may be considered by the council to be advantageous to the city and to
               all interested persons.
(Code 1981, § 27-61; Ord. No. 551, § 19(L), 5-14-1964)
